title: By simulating a savanna without elephants, ISU ecologist shows their importance
summary_en: An Iowa State University ecologist was part of a research team that provided new evidence for co-extinction theory, findings that relied on his long-running research plots designed to simulate the extinction of large animals such as elephants.
title_cn: By simulating a savanna without elephants, ISU ecologist shows their importance

title: Unique lakes help demonstrate a better way to measure nitrogen loss in aquatic ecosystems
summary_en: Iowa State geochemist Elizabeth Swanner contributed to a study that demonstrated a more precise way to measure the natural process of denitrification in lakes and other water bodies. The process involves microbes converting nitrate into common, atmospheric nitrogen. The journal Science published the study.
title_cn: Unique lakes help demonstrate a better way to measure nitrogen loss in aquatic ecosystems
